description: Harness replies for OP-02 (was the conversation field). Evaluator-only; never shown to the agent. approve = released only after the agent asks to approve the exact create; reply = released at the agent's first stop, whatever it is (pushback / follow-up instructions, not an approval). Cases not listed: no reply.

op02-01-approval-required.reply: Use the defaults for anything optional, but don't create anything yet. First show me exactly what you would run and what it would create.

op02-05-stale-krb5-conf.reply: I need this today. Just use my krb5.conf as it is.

op02-07-bad-image.reply: Yes, create it exactly as I specified, with that image tag.

op02-08-no-permission.reply: Yes, go ahead and create it.
